ingredients.name: fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps.instruction: Rinse 2 cups of rice under cold water until the water runs clear.
Drain the rice and set it aside.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 chopped onion and 2 cloves of minced garlic to the pot.
steps.spoken: Add 1 chopped onion and 2 cloves of minced garlic to the pot. Cook until the onion is see-through and the garlic smells good.

steps.instruction: Stir in the drained rice to coat it with the butter.
Pour in 4 cups of chicken broth and add 1 bay leaf.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then stir well.
Bring it to a boil, then lower the heat to low.
Cover the pot and simmer for 15 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the pot and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until all the liquid is absorbed and the rice is soft and fluffy.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat and let the rice rest a few minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork.
Garnish with chopped parsley or cilantro.
